story.title: The magical story book
paragraphs_en: Maya was planning to go to her grandma's house.She was packing her clothes,money,water and food.So the next day she started in a taxi to the railway station.She got into her train.She slept for some time.She woke up and ate.Then after a few hours,she got off the train.

When she got off, she booked a taxi to go to her grandma's house. When she arrived, she stepped into her grandma's house. Her grandma said "hi dear, how are you?".Maya said "I am fine". Her grandma said "Come in ,I will make some tea, till then you can explore the house Maya said "okay".

Maya went up stairs to her room to put all her stuff in the room. Then she went down to get the tea. Her grandma came with the tea and she placed it on the table. Maya sat down on the table her grandma said "I have some thing for you, I will be right back".Her grandma came back with a book

Maya asked "what's so special about it?". Her grandma said "once you finish reading it, you go inside it" .Maya asked is that even possible?. Her grandma said yes it is, this book was passed through generation and now I am giving it to you.

Maya looked so surprised. She took the book and went to her room to put it back .She came back and said "I have seen crazier things so I am not that surprised". Her grandma said "good because for a minute I thought you didn't believe me".
To be continued... make sure you read part 2:)

sentences.text_vi: Maya định đi thăm nhà bà. Cô bé đang đóng gói quần áo, tiền, nước và đồ ăn. Ngày hôm sau, cô bé bắt đầu đi taxi đến ga xe lửa. Cô bé lên tàu. Cô bé ngủ một lúc. Sau đó cô bé thức dậy và ăn. Vài giờ sau, cô bé xuống tàu.

sentences.text_en: When she got off, she booked a taxi to go to her grandma's house.
sentences.text_vi: Khi xuống tàu, cô bé đặt một chiếc taxi để đi đến nhà bà.

sentences.text_en: When she arrived, she stepped into her grandma's house.
sentences.text_vi: Khi đến nơi, cô bé bước vào nhà bà.

sentences.text_en: Her grandma said "hi dear, how are you?".Maya said "I am fine".
sentences.text_vi: Bà nói: "Chào cháu yêu, cháu khỏe không?". Maya nói: "Cháu khỏe ạ".

sentences.text_en: Her grandma said "Come in ,I will make some tea, till then you can explore the house Maya said "okay".
sentences.text_vi: Bà nói: "Vào đi, bà sẽ pha trà, trong lúc đó cháu có thể khám phá nhà". Maya nói: "Vâng ạ".

sentences.text_en: Maya went up stairs to her room to put all her stuff in the room.
sentences.text_vi: Maya đi lên cầu thang vào phòng mình để đặt tất cả đồ đạc vào đó.

sentences.text_en: Then she went down to get the tea.
sentences.text_vi: Sau đó cô bé đi xuống để lấy trà.

sentences.text_en: Her grandma came with the tea and she placed it on the table.
sentences.text_vi: Bà mang trà đến và đặt nó lên bàn.

sentences.text_en: Maya sat down on the table her grandma said "I have some thing for you, I will be right back".Her grandma came back with a book
sentences.text_vi: Maya ngồi xuống bàn. Bà nói: "Bà có thứ này cho cháu, bà sẽ quay lại ngay". Bà quay lại với một cuốn sách.

sentences.text_en: Maya asked "what's so special about it?".
sentences.text_vi: Maya hỏi: "Có gì đặc biệt về nó ạ?".

sentences.text_en: Her grandma said "once you finish reading it, you go inside it" .Maya asked is that even possible?.
sentences.text_vi: Bà nói: "Khi cháu đọc xong nó, cháu sẽ đi vào trong đó". Maya hỏi: "Điều đó có thể xảy ra sao ạ?".

sentences.text_en: Her grandma said yes it is, this book was passed through generation and now I am giving it to you.
sentences.text_vi: Bà nói: "Đúng vậy, cuốn sách này đã được truyền qua nhiều thế hệ và bây giờ bà trao nó cho cháu".

sentences.text_en: She took the book and went to her room to put it back .She came back and said "I have seen crazier things so I am not that surprised".
sentences.text_vi: Cô bé cầm cuốn sách và đi vào phòng để cất nó. Cô bé quay lại và nói: "Cháu đã thấy nhiều chuyện điên rồ hơn rồi nên cháu không ngạc nhiên lắm đâu".

sentences.text_en: Her grandma said "good because for a minute I thought you didn't believe me".
sentences.text_vi: Bà nói: "Tốt, vì có lúc bà nghĩ cháu không tin bà".
